description: Production Adsterra frames use ads.freecause.com, a dedicated origin sandboxed with allow-same-origin. The network still decides whether to return an advertisement.
application: A value whose host is the public site (or one of its aliases) is rejected by Ads::frameOrigin() and falls back to config/ads.php. Settings override config/ads.php and ADS_FRAME_ORIGIN. This reference is not executed automatically by deployment.
legacy_host: ads.freecause.com redirects to the corresponding canonical URL when it is no longer the configured frame host.
rollback: Remove the ads_frame_origin setting to fall back to config/ads.php (ADS_FRAME_ORIGIN, default https://ads.freecause.com).
